name: Athena off-site backup
desc: Daily Kopia snapshot of Athena backup shares to Backblaze B2 (home-lab#297). Pinged with the job exit status after snapshot and maintenance.

name: Athena Google Photos Takeout
desc: Daily pull of Google Takeout archives from Drive to Athena (home-lab#781). Pinged at the start of each run and with its status; a run fails when a pull or extraction fails or no archive has arrived for 40 days.
